description: This file implements a WebSocket client for a gateway service, managing connection lifecycle, authentication, message handling, reconnection logic, and TLS fingerprint validation.

classes.name: GatewayClientRequestError
classes.description: Custom error class for gateway request errors, including a gateway-specific code and optional details.

classes.name: GatewayClient
classes.description: Main WebSocket client class managing connection, authentication, message handling, reconnection, and TLS fingerprint validation.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes WebSocket connection, performs security checks, and sets up event handlers.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Requests the client to close the connection.

methods.name: stopAndWait
methods.description: Gracefully stops the client and waits for the connection to close, with optional timeout.

methods.name: beginStop
methods.description: Internal method to initiate stopping process, closing WebSocket and cleaning up.

methods.name: createPendingStop
methods.description: Creates a promise that resolves when the WebSocket is fully closed.

methods.name: resolvePendingStop
methods.description: Resolves the pending stop promise when WebSocket closes.

methods.name: sendConnect
methods.description: Sends a connect request over WebSocket with authentication and device info.

methods.name: resolveConnectScopes
methods.description: Determines the scope list for connection based on stored tokens and options.

methods.name: loadStoredDeviceAuth
methods.description: Loads stored device authentication token and scopes for a given role.

methods.name: shouldPauseReconnectAfterAuthFailure
methods.description: Decides whether to pause reconnection attempts after specific auth failure codes.

methods.name: shouldRetryWithStoredDeviceToken
methods.description: Determines if reconnection should retry using stored device token based on error and endpoint trust.

methods.name: isTrustedDeviceRetryEndpoint
methods.description: Checks if the current endpoint is trusted for device token retries.

methods.name: selectConnectAuth
methods.description: Selects appropriate authentication tokens for connection based on options and stored tokens.

methods.name: handleMessage
methods.description: Processes incoming WebSocket messages, handling events, responses, and errors.

methods.name: beginPreauthHandshake
methods.description: Prepares for the handshake by resetting nonce and setting timeout.

methods.name: clearConnectChallengeTimeout
methods.description: Clears the connect challenge timeout timer.

methods.name: armConnectChallengeTimeout
methods.description: Sets a timeout for the connect challenge phase.

methods.name: scheduleReconnect
methods.description: Schedules a reconnection attempt with exponential backoff.

methods.name: flushPendingErrors
methods.description: Rejects all pending requests with an error.

methods.name: startTickWatch
methods.description: Starts periodic checks for connection liveness based on last tick.

methods.name: validateTlsFingerprint
methods.description: Validates the server TLS fingerprint against expected value.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Sends a request over WebSocket and returns a promise for the response.
